Coffee is more than a drink. It’s a moment to pause, connect, and recharge.

Brewvora blends premium coffee with a modern lifestyle and crafts every cup with care, quality, and purpose. From the first sip to the last, the brand creates experiences that feel warm, memorable, and worth returning to.

One hand, one cup, one bean.

The mark offers a cup the way a good host would. A rounded wordmark keeps it friendly, and the tagline sits in clean Montserrat capitals.

Roasted Mahogany#521D18
Golden Crema#E9AF58
Steamed Cream#FDE5BB, the page and mockup backdrop

Packaging that carries the pattern.

A hand-drawn doodle set of cups, croissants, grinders and “Coffee Lover” lettering wraps every surface, in tone-on-tone gold on mahogany.

Spaces, in two moods.

The same pattern becomes a feature wall, golden for a bright daytime room and roasted mahogany for the evening.

Mugs and uniforms.

Enamel mugs flip the logo for a playful upside-down back print. The staff jacket carries a simple name badge.
